items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to restore interrupted services where restoration is within its reasonable control.
items.span_text: In the event of the interruption of any such service, however, Landlord shall employ commercially reasonable efforts to restore such service or cause the same to be restored in any circumstances in which such restoration is within the reasonable control of Landlord.
items.trigger: In the event of the interruption of any such service

items.description: Landlord must reasonably cooperate, at no cost to Tenant, with Tenant's SAS 70 or similar audits, including providing reasonable access to records.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to reasonably cooperate with Tenant, at no cost to Tenant, in regards to Tenant’s conduct of any audit of (a) Tenant’s operations in the Tenant Space and/or (b) the maintenance and operation of the Building

items.anchor_event: Landlord’s receipt of the final SAS 70 Audit report
items.description: Landlord must give Tenant a copy of the final report of any SAS 70 Audit it causes to be performed, within thirty days after receiving it.
items.span_text: in the event that Landlord causes a SAS 70 Audit to be performed with regard to (a) or (b), above, during the Term of the Lease, Landlord agrees to provide Tenant (within thirty (30) days after Landlord’s receipt of same) a copy of the final report that Landlord receives as a result of each such SAS 70 Audit
items.trigger: in the event that Landlord causes a SAS 70 Audit to be performed with regard to (a) or (b), above, during the Term of the Lease

items.description: Tenant may not perform Landlord's maintenance or repair obligations itself (no self-help right).
items.span_text: Tenant shall not have the right to perform any of Landlord’s maintenance and/or repair obligations under Section 8.1, below

items.description: Landlord must maintain and keep in good repair, at its own cost, the listed infrastructure and building systems serving the Premises.
items.span_text: Landlord will maintain and keep in good repair at Landlord’s sole cost and expense the Pathway, the PDUs serving the Premises, Landlord’s Access Control Systems, the HVAC system and plumbing, if any, serving the Premises, the UPS Plant serving the Premises, the Back-Up Power, the fire suppression systems serving the Premises

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant its PM Schedule as far in advance as reasonably practicable.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide Tenant with Landlord’s PM Schedule as far in advance as is reasonably practicable.

items.description: Landlord must perform the PM Activities and substantially adhere to the current PM Schedule.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to perform the PM Activities and to substantially adhere to the then current PM Schedule in connection with such performance.

items.anchor_event: date upon which Tenant desires to perform its PM Audit
items.description: Tenant must deliver a PM Audit Notice at least thirty days before the desired audit date.
items.span_text: Tenant shall exercise the foregoing right by delivering its PM Audit Notice to Landlord no less than thirty (30) days before the date upon which Tenant desires to perform its PM Audit.

items.anchor_event: Landlord’s receipt of Tenant’s PM Audit Notice
items.description: Landlord must respond to the PM Audit Notice within five business days with the audit date, time and location.
items.span_text: Landlord shall respond to Tenant’s PM Audit Notice within five (5) business days after Landlord’s receipt of Tenant’s PM Audit Notice with the date, time and location of Tenant’s PM Audit.

items.description: If the PM Audit reveals delinquency, Tenant must give written notice and Landlord must cure within the time allowed under Section 16.1.1.
items.span_text: If Tenant’s PM Audit reveals that Landlord is delinquent in complying with the PM Schedule, Tenant shall deliver written notice to Landlord of such delinquency, and Landlord shall cure such delinquency within the time allowed pursuant to Section 16.1.1 of this Lease.
items.trigger: If Tenant’s PM Audit reveals that Landlord is delinquent in complying with the PM Schedule

items.description: Tenant must maintain the Tenant Space and its equipment in good order and in clean, safe condition at its own cost.
items.span_text: During the Term of this Lease, Tenant shall, at Tenant’s sole cost and expense, maintain the Tenant Space and Tenant’s equipment therein in good order and in a clean and safe condition.

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord's maintenance and repair costs plus an administrative charge as Additional Rent within thirty days after demand.
items.span_text: any amounts expended by Landlord in connection therewith, plus an administrative charge of ten percent (10%) of such amounts, shall be reimbursed by Tenant to Landlord as Additional Rent within thirty (30) days after Landlord’s demand therefor.
items.trigger: if Tenant fails to perform its covenants of maintenance and repair hereunder

items.description: Tenant must obtain Landlord's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, before making Alterations.
items.span_text: Tenant shall not make or cause to be made any Alterations to the Tenant Space or any other portion of the Building or Property without the prior written consent and approval of Landlord, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed.

items.description: Landlord's Installations must be left in the Tenant Space in good and operable condition at lease end, subject to wear and tear and casualty.
items.span_text: all Landlord’s Installations shall be left as part of the Tenant Space, upon the expiration or earlier termination of this Lease, in good and operable condition, ordinary wear and tear and damage by fire or other casualty excepted.
items.trigger: upon the expiration or earlier termination of this Lease

items.description: Each Alterations consent request must include a full-size hard copy of the drawings and a full set on CD.
items.span_text: Each request for Alterations consent must contain one (1) full size hard copy of all drawings together with one (1) full set of drawings on CD.

items.description: Tenant's contractors and others must obtain and evidence insurance reasonably required by Landlord before entry, not exceeding the requirements in Exhibit B-1.
items.span_text: all such contractors, laborers, material men and others must obtain (and provide Landlord evidence of) such insurance as Landlord may reasonably require, prior to any such entry

items.description: Upon expiration or termination, Tenant must promptly remove its Personal Property and restore damaged portions at its own cost.
items.span_text: Tenant shall at Tenant’s sole cost and expense, promptly remove all of Tenant’s Personal Property, and shall restore those portions of the Building and/or the Tenant Space damaged by such removal of (or by the initial installation of) such Tenant’s Personal Property
items.trigger: upon the expiration or earlier termination of this Lease

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord's removal and restoration costs plus an administrative fee within thirty days of demand.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to reimburse Landlord within thirty (30) days of Landlord’s demand therefor, for all of Landlord’s actual and reasonable out of pocket costs of removal and restoration plus an administrative fee equal to five percent (5%) of such costs.
items.trigger: If Tenant fails to promptly remove any such Tenant’s Personal Property pursuant to this Section 8.4
